name: Wireworld Circuits
desc: A living luminous circuit board where electron heads trail glowing comet-tails as they race forever around auto-generated beveled conductor loops, a self-sustaining Wireworld cellular automaton rendered as cyan traces, copper PCB, green phosphor CRT, magenta neon, or gold leadframe.

density.doc: how densely the board fills with wire loops + electrons

scale.doc: trace zoom (higher = bigger loops, fewer tiles)
